description: The /load implementation places loading and continue inside the no-filename branch.
trigger: Enter /load saved.json in the interactive chat loop.
expected_behavior: Read the requested session and return to command input without generating a response to the command.
actual_behavior: len(c) is greater than one, so load_session is never called. Execution falls through to context.append and treats the command text as a user prompt.
